description: Create or update a reusable channel group (up to 50 per brand) bundling connected accounts from accounts_list so recurring posts target the same roster in one step. Every account must be connected in this brand.

accountIds.description: One to 100 connected account ids from accounts_list in this brand. Required when creating.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: An existing channel group id from channel_groups_list to update. Leave out to create a new group.

name.description: A short name for this account group (1 to 60 characters), such as "B2B Launch" or "Short Video". Required when creating.

note.description: An optional note describing when to use this channel group (up to 200 characters). Pass null or empty string to clear.

name: channel_groups_save
title: Save a channel group
